command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== baseline: boot id =="
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
echo "== step: create appworker user =="
if id appworker >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "appworker already exists"
else
  sudo -n useradd -m -s /bin/bash appworker
  echo "created appworker"
fi
id appworker

echo "== step: write limits.d config =="
sudo -n tee /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf > /dev/null <<'EOF'
appworker soft nofile 8192
appworker hard nofile 8192
appworker soft nproc 256
appworker hard nproc 256
EOF
cat /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf

echo "== verify: limits applied for login session =="
sudo -n -u appworker -i bash -c 'ulimit -Hn; ulimit -Sn; ulimit -Hu; ulimit -Su'
